# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixture files for integration and unit tests.

## Planned Fixtures

- `cp866_russian.dbf` - DBF file with CP866 Cyrillic encoding
- `cp1251_russian.dbf` - DBF file with Windows-1251 Cyrillic encoding
- `cp1255_hebrew.dbf` - DBF file with Windows-1255 Hebrew encoding
- `corrupted_records.dbf` - DBF file with corrupted records for error handling tests

These fixtures will be created as part of Phase 4 (User Story 2 - DBF to CSV Conversion).
